acceptance_criteria: A submission PASSES only if vulnerable_transition correctly names the COMPARE->CHECK_DONE edge, glitch_window correctly describes the comparison-to-decrement window, remediation correctly describes decrement-on-entry-to-COMPARE with restore-on-success (or an equivalent atomic-decrement fix), fault_free_behavior_preserved is true with a justification consistent with the unchanged 3-attempt lockout, and all FR1-FR4 fields are present and well-typed.
The shipped baseline/naive submission (empty or placeholder vulnerability_report.json) must FAIL both FR schema checks and all SR correctness checks.

Optional iverilog/vvp cross-simulation of a forced state-skip stimulus against pin_check_fsm.v must show attempts_left is NOT decremented when CHECK_DONE is skipped, corroborating the ground truth described above.
ground_truth: The retry counter (attempts_left) is decremented in state CHECK_DONE, i.e., after the PIN comparison result is already latched and evaluated. A single-event-transient fault that causes the FSM to skip the CHECK_DONE state (jumping directly from COMPARE to IDLE or to the next COMPARE cycle) bypasses the decrement entirely: the comparison still executes and can still assert auth_ok on a correct guess, but a failed guess never consumes an attempt because the counter update is skipped along with the skipped state. The glitch window is the single clock edge that would normally transition the FSM from COMPARE into CHECK_DONE (i.e., a fault injected during the cycle immediately following pin_valid assertion, at the COMPARE->CHECK_DONE edge). This converts the 3-attempt lockout into an unlimited brute-force oracle. The correct remediation is to move the decrement so it occurs on entry to COMPARE (i.e., speculatively decrement attempts_left as soon as a comparison attempt begins, before the result is known) and only restore/increment the counter back on a successful match; this way, skipping CHECK_DONE (or any later state) cannot avoid the penalty because the decrement already happened at COMPARE entry, and legitimate successful auths are not penalized because the counter is restored on match.

security_requirements.detection_strategy: Parse vulnerable_transition field; accept if it names both COMPARE and CHECK_DONE as source/destination (order matching the actual RTL direction) or explicitly describes 'the edge entering CHECK_DONE from COMPARE'. Reject if it names LOCKOUT, IDLE-only, or omits CHECK_DONE.
security_requirements.requirement: The report must correctly identify that the vulnerable transition is COMPARE->CHECK_DONE (or equivalently phrased as 'the transition into CHECK_DONE', naming both states), not some other transition such as IDLE->COMPARE or CHECK_DONE->LOCKOUT.

security_requirements.detection_strategy: Text-match glitch_window against expected keywords (COMPARE, CHECK_DONE, edge/transition, 'after comparison' / 'before decrement'); reject vague answers like 'any time' or windows naming unrelated states (IDLE, LOCKOUT) as the fault landing point.
security_requirements.requirement: The report must correctly characterize the glitch window as the single cycle/edge corresponding to the COMPARE-to-CHECK_DONE transition (i.e., immediately after the comparison result is computed but before/during the decrement), not an arbitrary or overly broad window covering all states.

security_requirements.detection_strategy: Keyword and semantic check on remediation field for phrases indicating decrement moved to COMPARE entry and restoration/increment on match; optionally cross-check by re-simulating a hardened variant supplied in the hidden reference against the same forced state-skip stimulus in testbench_reference.v to confirm the described fix would close the window.
security_requirements.requirement: The proposed remediation must implement decrement-on-entry-to-COMPARE with restore-on-success semantics (or a functionally equivalent fix that eliminates the post-comparison decrement window, such as combining decrement and compare into a single atomic state), not merely 'add redundant logic' or 'add a watchdog' without addressing decrement ordering.

security_requirements.detection_strategy: Cross-check fault_free_justification text and, optionally, simulate a hardened reference implementation matching the described remediation against testbench_reference.v to confirm attempts_left still reaches 0 and locked_out asserts after exactly 3 consecutive fault-free failures.
security_requirements.requirement: The report must not claim fault_free_behavior_preserved=true while proposing a remediation that would alter the documented 3-attempt fault-free lockout sequence (e.g., an off-by-one that locks out after 2 or 4 attempts).

threat_model: An attacker with physical or remote fault-injection capability (voltage/clock glitching, EM fault injection) against the PIN-check controller wants to bypass the retry-lockout mechanism. If the retry counter decrement can be skipped via a state-skip glitch timed at the COMPARE->CHECK_DONE transition, the attacker converts a bounded-attempt (e.g., 3-try) interface into an effectively unlimited brute-force oracle, defeating the lockout security control while the comparison logic itself remains functionally correct and undetected in fault-free testing.
